items.title: iPhone 13 Mini and Digging
items.summary: As stated in the previous post, I ordered an iPhone 13 Mini. As someone who's always been a power user on Android phones, it's strange. I do not like how the notifications work, but it'll just take some time getting used to. Plus, this way I'm more likely to miss the…
items.content_html:
As stated in the previous post, I ordered an iPhone 13 Mini. As someone who's always been a power user on Android phones, it's strange. I do not like how the notifications work, but it'll just take some time getting used to. Plus, this way I'm more likely to miss the non-important notifications, so I guess that's a feature, not a bug? I ported my photos over to iCloud from Google Photos via Google Takeout, so that was easy. For everything else, I moved what I wanted manually. I'm not installing any games, no power apps... just the basics like banking, authenticators, communication, and minor entertainment apps. 
It's been about a week using only the iPhone and I can't say I miss the Android OS as much as I thought I would, honestly. But only because I specifically went iOS to not use the phone as much. You can't customize it nearly as much and can't sideload apps (unless you jailbreak, which I'm not)... but all in all, I don't hate it. I have what I need and things just work. I could see myself sticking with the Apple ecosystem in the future is I don't start craving the power user aspects of phone use again. Not because it's better, but because its worse for my use case.
Everything I was worried about, I was able to move over fairly easily. The hardest thing was the podcasts, which wasn't too bad, really. I use Podcast Addict on Android, but that app is not available on iOS. I did not like the Apple Podcast app, so I found PocketCast. The cool thing about that one is I was able to import all the subrsciptions over from Podcast Addict to it on my Android phone. I just had to manually mark which episodes were played. After that, I signed in on the same account on the iPhone and it synced everything over. Easy. As for music, I'm using 8SPINE for playing specific songs/playlists and Amazon Music if I was to start a station based on a song/artist. It's slightly more cumbersome, but 8SPINE's station feature isn't really working currently. At least for me.

My parent's helped me get the old house closer to being ready today. Things are sectioned out. The big thing today was we moved my old truck to my new place. So now I'll have it close by and put more time into trying to get that starter motor replaced! While we were loading that, the neighbor that cuts the field for hay stopped by and when I asked if he knew anyone with a mini excavator, he asked what for... And ended up coming back with his tractor that has a backhoe on it. He dug the trench and hole I'll need for replacing the old gray water septic tank in like 15 minutes and wouldn't accept anything for it. Now I'll just have to finish digging what's inside the fence, but I already have that about 75% of the way there. But him doing that was very nice and saved us a lot of manual labor.

Tonight, I streamed for a while on Twitch, utilizing the new headset that can pair to my Steam Deck and laptop simultaneously. My brother and friend were watching and queued songs for the bot to play as well. It all seemed to work very well; the viewers hearing the music fine, game fine, and myself not having things doubled. I just have to go into an app called qpwgraph and sever the audio connection from SteamLink and the headset. Takes like 2 seconds to do before starting up. With how flawlessly it worked tonight, I could see myself keeping this setup for a lot longer. Not worry about getting a desktop anytime soon.

Not that I was thinking about a desktop computer soon, anyway. As it stands right now, the order of operations is: sell the house, buy a 12'x24' garage to be delivered, then get a UTV. Initially I was thinking a single bench seat UTV like the Polaris Ranger 590, as it's the smallest one that would be good for the steep graded hills I live on... But thinking about it more, I may want something that has a second row of seats. That way when the kids are a little bigger, there's more room. Plus if my mom or someone else wanted to ride with me and the kids somewhere, they'd have space. A single bench seat would not. But that'll be after the garage, so I'm not activately looking for anything yet. I may even look into carports before a UTV. Certainly will get another dump truck load or two of gravel delivered before then. For the driveway. 

Other things I'm not ready to fully disclose yet may be coming to a big breaking point soon, which is good. Just waiting on some clarification, but it sounds like agreements have been pretty much made. Just pray it works out, please.

I've also recently started talking to an old friend again. We hadn't talked in about six years, but it doesn't feel like it's been that long. It feels pretty natural. I feel like it'd a Godsend to have someone to talk about what's going on who isn't polarized about it. We got together and played a few board games recently, which was really nice.

And as always, hope anyone reading this is having a good day. Feel free to message me through one of the options in the Links page!

items.title: Demoting the Phone and Other Updates
items.summary: Typically I buy refurbished or heavily discounted phones. Not cheap ones, mind you, but flagships from a year or two ago. The phone I'm currently using is a Samsung Galaxy Fold 3. I got it for a steal a while back, but found myself almost never using the larger inner…
items.content_html:
Typically I buy refurbished or heavily discounted phones. Not cheap ones, mind you, but flagships from a year or two ago. The phone I'm currently using is a Samsung Galaxy Fold 3. I got it for a steal a while back, but found myself almost never using the larger inner screen. A week or so ago, I took my case off to clean the back and the back of the phone came off, too. Everything is in tact, no battery swelling, so likely just adhesive failure and not a big deal. But I've been thinking about getting a new phone for a while, so this started the hunt. Then, the next day, I dropped my phone on gravel and one of the pieces hit perfectly between the screen protector and the case, cracking both the protector and the phone itself. See below for pictures. This solified that I'll get a new phone.
At first, I realized I missed using the S Pen on my old Samsung Galaxy Note 9, so I was looking into the S's Ultra series and had my eyes set on the Galaxy S24 Ultra. A large beast of a phone that would do everything I wanted. I've always been an Android power user, sideloading apps, utlizing widgets, etc, so it just made sense. But then I got to thinking... There was a time I seriously considered the Unihertz Jelly Star; a tiny Android phone with just a 3 inch screen. And more recently, the BigMe HiBreak Pro; a phone that has an E-ink display. Both were considered just to make my phone less important in my life. Both avoided due to not being super practical. The Jelly Star wouldn't get updates for bugs and such most likely and would be a little too small. And the HiBreak likely wouldn't support the right phone signal bands in my area so service would be poor. 
So, the phone I decided to go with is an iPhone 13 Mini. I don't have it yet, but it is on the way. I never thought I'd even try Apple, but I feel like this is the only way I'll transition the phone into the tool it belongs, instead of being an addiction. I ordered a watch as well, as my Galaxy watch isn't compatible with iPhones. But all in all, the cost is roughly half of what I was looking at for the S24 Ultra. First order of business when it arrives will be migrating the essentials: banking, credit cards, authenticators, and so on... Making sure they all work. After verifying those, I'll move set up communication, calendars, podcasts, and music. Then my SIM card. It'll be mostly a fresh start - no games. I know TikTok and Reddit will end up on it, but I plan to be far more deliberate about the tiem spent on them. Actually using the Digital Wellbeing utilities baked into phones and putting it down while picking up my Kindle to read more. Which is something I don't think I'll be good at in the Android ecosystem. Apple locks things down more, so there's less to go and discover/try. Plus, worst case, this experiment lasts a month or two and I switch back. Best case, I stay off my phone a lot more and learn to enjoy life with one less addiction. I have the Steam Deck for games, Kindle for reading, laptop for most other things, etc...

Speaking of the Steam Deck, I did purchase a headset that should be able to mix audio from two different sources. This means I should be able to connect it to both the Steam Deck and the laptop. That way, I can play games with no audio lag while listening to music and/or talk in a Discord voice channel on the laptop. I've already set up music to work with PhantomBot and I think I have OBS set up properly to stream the music, but not record it in the VODs - so if I post anything, there shouldn't be any copyrighted music in it. I did a small trial (without the headset), but the music was a little choppy, so I may have to do some more tinkering or scrap the music idea. We'll see.

My girls are doing great! Happy and healthy. Sleeping through the nights. Being normal toddlers. My three year old is in that stage where she's asking more and more questions and it's interesting to hear. Hard to answer, sometimes, though! Then my two year old just likes to ask "Why?" They're both great kids. My dog, Bianca, is probably close to ten years old and is a mix of who knows what, but she's a small/medium sized dog. See below for a picture of her pretending to be a chicken. They love her and she puts up with them very well. My youngest likes to put blankets on her. It's fun to watch.

Getting a little more progress done at the old house. Today, I removed everything from the upstairs in the shed and took it home. Except for some old swords/knives I do not have a place for currently. I'll figure out something for those later. All that's left is clearing out the bottom floor, which should be do-able this weekend, and moving the things I think someone may want to the front of the storage unit I've rented. After that, cleaning, painting, and general repairs. I've decided I'm going to rent a mini-excavator to dig the gray water line/tank I need to replace. I didn't realize it's usually only a few hundred to rent one and that would save my family's backs from having to dig and definitely allow it to be knocked out a lot quicker.

I also recently pulled out an iPad Mini 4 I bought years ago for... some reason I don't remember. Possibly just the game FTL. I don't know. But I'm converting it into a digital recipe book using the app Paprika. I haven't loaded much into it yet, but I did stick a magsafe ring on the back of its case and put a magsafe mount above my sink for ease of use. I think that'll be a great use for it while I work on getting my cooking back into full swing after this move. Plus, it'll make making shopping lists easy. 

For this site, I've replaced the "Contact Me" page with a "Links" page and will try to make it a little more fancy later on.

items.title: DakBoard, Backup Dashboard, and Twitch Audio
items.summary: I bit the bullet and bought a refurbished monitor for setting up as an electronic wall calendar. Just mounted it today and it makes me think I should have gone with a larger size! Oh well, it'll still be nice to have and I can always upgrade later if desired.Cool…
items.content_html:
I bit the bullet and bought a refurbished monitor for setting up as an electronic wall calendar. Just mounted it today and it makes me think I should have gone with a larger size! Oh well, it'll still be nice to have and I can always upgrade later if desired.Cool thing about it is the USB ports on it can provide power for the Raspberry Pi, so there's only one cable leaving the back of the monitor (power). The rest of them are managed where you can't see them from the front. It's got the next time and date, the calendar showing the next four weeks, and five days of weather on the right. I like it.

I've mentioned it before, but at work, the local team uses a dashboard I set up to make our day-to-day easier. I had to re-make it in a few system recently, for which they said we'd be able to create dashboards again in... Well, just this week, they took away my ability to share it with new people again. So I'm updating links to a backup dashboard I have on this site in case they go and delete the  self-made dashboards... The one on here is essentially just a links repository with formatting, so nothing special. They can't really take that away... But as it stands right now, we have two new people starting and I can't share the main dashboard with them. I think users can still make their own dashboards, so I'll try just borrowing their computer and rebuilding it from scratch for their user accounts. It is much easier to see the numbers in one place rather than having to click the links in the backup... or use the convoluted dashboard the admins are wanting us to use.

The bot I use for Twitch, PhantomBot, has the option to add songs to a queue and such. With my current setup, I wouldn't be able to hear the music at the same time as watchers, so I haven't bothered setting it up. However, I've recently discovered that audio-mixing headphones are a thing. Like the SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7. It would allow me to use a USB dongle with the Steam Deck to hear the game, but also allow me to use bluetooth with my laptop to hear the music and Discord. It's a little pricey, but seems worth it. I've added the Nova 7 to my wishlist and will be looking out for sales/refurbs. I can't justify spending much on it currently, so it'll come later. But I love the idea of allowing chat to queue up songs.

My daughters are doing great, by the way. They love playing with their toys and having me read books. Currently, their song obsession is "Story of a Worm" by Sarah Maddack. I think I listened to that song about 30 times today... but it is a fun one. Here recently, when we come back up the hill to my house from my parents' house, they just want to play outuside on their little castle before going inside. Which is good for them, so I'm usually just standing there watching for 30 or so minutes before telling them it's time to go inside and wind down, getting ready for dinner (or bathtime if we ate at my parents'). When people say, "They grow up so fast,"  they mean it. It's crazy how fast they grow. It's also very noticable how much difference one year apart makes in these early years. But I'm also really glad they're so close in age as they typically play together very well. And it's apparent that they love each other very much. I wouldn't trade them for the world.

items.title: Where'd My Face Go? And Other Updates
items.summary: Last weekend I got a little done at the old house -- just moving what was already boxed up or bagged up to the storage unit. 10' x 10' seems so small, but it should be plenty of space for my needs. It just feels so strange moving things into a…
items.content_html:
Last weekend I got a little done at the old house -- just moving what was already boxed up or bagged up to the storage unit. 10' x 10' seems so small, but it should be plenty of space for my needs. It just feels so strange moving things into a storage unit. I rented one from a brand new local facility, so it is clean. They also provided the lock for free, if I return it with both keys afterwards. Otherwise, it's just the cost of a decent lock I'd owe. I still have a lot to do in terms of packing and moving, but progress is progress. I did replace the broken front porch light at my new place, at least.

I also streamed for a little bit on Twitch this past weekend, but it wasn't great. I tried Dark Souls 3 for the first time in years and did terrible. Then switched over to TCG Card Shop Simulator, which I don't think would be fitting for the audience I'd like. Probably mostly play that offline when I want to just chill. I did download Dark Souls 1 on the steam deck after this stream, as it's my favorite Dark Souls... I don't have the Remastered Edition, but I did install DSFix, so we'll see how it goes. Probably start a new game on that and run with it for a while.

Kids are both doing well! They love playing around the farm during day, being mermaids at bathtime, and reading before bed. Tonight when we came back up to my house, they didn't want to go inside. So they played all over their slide/climbing structure for a good 30 minutes before I had us go inside to take a bath. Also, the other night, I trimmed my beard short and my 3 year old asked me, "Daddy, why did you cut your face off?" That got a laugh out of me. I think I still have a face? People at work haven't freaked out, so I don't look that horrific.

Tomorrow I'm getting my brakes replaced and possibly wheel bearings replaced on my car. The brakes are starting to grind at lower speeds and last time I had service done, they mentioned the wheel bearings would need to be replaced soon, so may as well have them done at the same time. I'll just have to borrow my parents' farm truck to get to work while it's in the shop. But it is a necessity to keep my car up and running well. After things settle now, I'll have to get my farm truck fixed, so I won't have to borrow a vehicle in these moments. Plus I could leave the farm truck at work when I'm on call and make it easier over-all. But that'll be a ways down the line.

I've been thinking about ordering energy powder online from the likes of GFuel, AdvancedGG, etc... But I've decided I'll make my own mocha instant coffee powder to mix with milk and/or water in the mornings instead. Instant coffee, unsweetened cocoa, monk fruit for sweetener, powdered milk for creaminess, a little salt... I haven't done it yet, but I've got the items needed in my Walmart cart to buy next time I get groceries. If you have any good recommendations for DIY energy powders or coffees, feel free to send them my way!

items.title: No Progress and Other Updates
items.summary: I still haven't been able to make progress on getting my house ready to sell... But I did go ahead and rent a storage unit! This weekend I'll move all of the boxes/bags I have packed into it. It doesn't sound like I'll be doing much, but every little bit…
items.content_html:
I still haven't been able to make progress on getting my house ready to sell... But I did go ahead and rent a storage unit! This weekend I'll move all of the boxes/bags I have packed into it. It doesn't sound like I'll be doing much, but every little bit helps. It just needs to get done. Pray I'll get the time to!

My Twitch got an upgrade: a bot. I found a self-hosted Twitch bot called PhantomBot and got it set up. It's mostly still the defaults, but it'll be a nice little tool to have during the streams. And as time goes on, I'll add more commands and behaviors as I see fit. I still haven't streamed again, but it's rather fun just tinkering with the program. I've got it installed on my laptop and will run it only when streaming or messing with the settings. It was tempting to install it on my server computer, but decided it doesn't need to run all the time.

Speaking of the server computer, I don't think I've wrote about it yet. I'm running Ubuntu Server on my old desktop. It's mainly for JellyFin, a self-hosted media server. I've got some movies and TV shows on it. I also have a Minecraft server running on it for a small Christian Discord group I'm in. I don't think anyone's been on it, as they have a Realm they play occasionally, but I use Java, soooo.... I figured why not make one both Java and Bedrock can join.

The next thing I'll probably do with this website is change the "Contact" page to a "Links" page and have the email and Telegram links still, but also Tiktok, Youtube, Twitch, Steam, and so on... Like a self-hosted Linktree/Carrds. I'm not sure when I'll get around to actually doing that, but I think it'll be nice to have! Especially if I start posting/streaming more.

It's currently 23:55 as I'm typing this part as I got called into work whilst working on this post. It was an easy fix, but pushed my bedtime back, I guess? I got back home wide awake. So it goes. Tomorrow I'm supposed to leave work early anyway, as I stayed late to get some harder-to-access units PMed Tuesday. So hopefully the lack of sleep will be accompanied by a nice, easy, short day. Doubtful, but why not hope?

Anyway, I hope everyone (probably no one) reading this is having a good day! God bless!

items.title: Janky Twitch and Sickly Kids
items.summary: I did a trial stream on Twitch last night. I guess my laptop was updating when I was just seeing if it would even work the other day, because while streaming and recording, my CPU usage stayed around 30%. It was a nice surprise. I didn't post or tell anyone…
items.content_html:
I did a trial stream on Twitch last night. I guess my laptop was updating when I was just seeing if it would even work the other day, because while streaming and recording, my CPU usage stayed around 30%. It was a nice surprise. I didn't post or tell anyone I was going to go live, but someone from one of the communities I watch joined and said hi, which was kind of them. The setup is definitely a little janky, but it seems to be working well. I just don't know how I'd be able to do a voice chat with someone if I decide to play with people unless it's an in-game chat. But that would be a ways away. I've added my pngtuber below so you can see some of the jank here. It reminds me of Monty Python's Flying Circus opening scenes.

After the stream, I used Shotcut and trimmed the video to a fail and posted it on TikTok. Shotcut took a while to figure out, because I wanted it in a verticle format with my avatar talking in the lower right side still, but eventually I figured it out. Insomnia definitely played a role, but that's okay.

So yeah, I'll probably randomly stream on Twitch and try to post funny clips from it on TikTok. I imagine it'll only be like once or twice a month, but still! TikTok will probably get more random, non game related content, too.

And yes, as the title suggests, both my kids have been a bit sick recently. So please keep them in your prayers. Their little bodies are working through one of the many things going around right now. But they're mostly happy still. Just means longer naps, more pushing liquids, and less appetites... But I know they'll get through it. I'm taking tomorrow off to take care of them. It'll be a chill day with movies, playing with toys, and generally resting.

As for my old house, I'm still in the process of cleaning it out and packing stuff up we don't need... Schedule-wise, it's been impossible to have much time to work on that, so there's still a lot to do. I'm hoping to get it all done and the house listed within a couple of months, but at this rate, I just don't know... So pray for that, too. While financially, I'll be okay, it would be a huge burden off my shoulders to get that house fixed up and sold.

On an random note, I only just found out Monster Energy "Rehab" drinks are still caffeinated. I assumed the "rehab" part was for people who were trying to cut back on caffeine... But it's just non-carbonated drinks like tea? I had to pick one up because I prefer my energy drinks non-carbonated and like teas. I have yet to try it, but it grabbed peach tea.

items.title: No More Manual Site Code and Other Updates
items.summary: Well, I've decided to got away from just coding the website myself at all and am going with a static CMS generator. I thought about using Hugo, but didn't really care for it / have the time to learn it. Instead, at the time of this post, I'm converting my…
items.content_html:
Well, I've decided to got away from just coding the website myself at all and am going with a static CMS generator. I thought about using Hugo, but didn't really care for it / have the time to learn it. Instead, at the time of this post, I'm converting my website into Publii. It's free and clean. Had to manually move my blog posts over, but that didn't take too long. I think I have everything set up, but I'm sure I'll discover something that needs tweaked or added later on... I actually like the default "Simple" theme the most of the options I looked at, so here we are. 

Life has been... full of chaos and change. I've moved into the house up the hill from my parents and am currently boxing up/cleaning my old house before I can sell it. I've had to buy all new household items, but I think I'm about fully set up. Just need to organize the things I have better and get a storage unit for the things in my old house I'm not taking.

My two daughters are doing well. Happy and healthy, for the most part. I love getting greeted by running hugs when I get home! They love the new place. Probaby helps that they can see Grandma and Grandpa's house just down the hill from our porches. I'm doing pretty well, too. Still have a lot of work to do, but it is what it is. 

I may start randomly streaming on Twitch. If I do, I imagine it'd only be like once or twice a month and quality would be a little odd. I'd be using the Steam Link app on my old rugged laptop to stream the audo/video to OBS from my Steam Deck and using Veadotube Mini to have my little icon indicate when I speak. So definitely a little janky. But could be fun! May post more on TikTok, too. Who knows. I'll have a little more free time than I'm used to once I get the moving pains / house selling out of the way.

It's a chaotic time in life currently. All I ask is that you pray for my girls. That's all I'm willing to say right now.

I likely will not update this blog for quite a while while things are getting sorted. But if you want to reach out, feel free to click that email button on the top right of the page!

items.title: Break. Reset, 30?
items.summary: Well, it's been a rough week. And I've talked to several people and learned a lot. Spent a lot of time with God. One thing I've learned is that I've got to start spending time for myeself. Not wait until I have time, but make time. I've ordered kayak mounts…
items.content_html:
Well, it's been a rough week. And I've talked to several people and learned a lot. Spent a lot of time with God. One thing I've learned is that I've got to start spending time for myeself. Not wait until I have time, but make time. I've ordered kayak mounts for my car so I can go kayaking occasionally. I'm also going to start walking more - likely with my kids at the local park. It'll be helpful to just get back out into nature. And on the days the weather isn't good? Well, I wanted to learn to wittle a while back and never really spent time on it. I have the stuff, so why not? Make the time.

The last couple of days has been like a mental reset. I got more sleep, read the Bible, etc. It's been good. Now to go back into life and take all I've learned and take care of myself. That way I can take care of others better. You can't really love others well if you don't love yourself. And that's been a struggle. So it's time to show myself I'm worthy of love. Worthy of time. So I can also give it to others.

In other news, I just turned 30 this past weekend! I feel the same, but it is odd thinking I'm in a whole new decade now. I had to go do the DMV and get my license renewed... but otherwise, there isn't anything special about it. Just another day, you know?

We're rehoming our puppy my wife really wanted today, unfortunately. The puppy wire haired pointed griffin was just too much for us in this time of life with the health stuff and kids. My wife made the call, but it is for the best... She had way too much energy for us to keep her entertained and happy. So she'll go to a home with a poodle and a guy that travels a lot and be able to get that excess energy out. She'll be better out there than in this home with two old lazy dogs. It's saddening it had to go this way, though. She's a sweet dog... but yeah.

And as usually, if you're a praying person, please pray for my family and I. Lord knows we need it. Thanks.

items.title: A Little Rock and Little Rocks
items.summary: So recently, my wife and I went to Little Rock to see another specialist. The wait was long and frustrating, but the doctor made up for it by being very kind and understanding. He does think she has POTS and a certain type. At the end of this month, we've…
items.content_html:
So recently, my wife and I went to Little Rock to see another specialist. The wait was long and frustrating, but the doctor made up for it by being very kind and understanding. He does think she has POTS and a certain type. At the end of this month, we've got to go back to his office to do another tilt table test as he doesn't like how the place she got hers done performs theirs. My wife came out of the appointment hopeful.

My girls have been sick all last week with Strep, COVID, and RVS, so that's been fun. Their antibiotics definitely worked, though; they're both feeling better now. In turn, my wife is now sick. She's on antibiotics now, too. I've had a slight cough for like a month, but other than that, I've been fine.

My daughters have started calling small rocks and sprinkles 'little rocks' for some reason. Unsure why, but it's cute.

It's time to start mowing again, unfortunately. It is currently Wednesday and I have to mow everything before Saturday due to an easter egg hunt my wife is hosting at our house. And I can't tonight... So tomorrow or Friday, it is. Hooray. I'm not huge on hosting things... or going to events in general... but now I have a wife and kids, so it's a sacrifice I must make.

Work hase been fun! Sarcasm, by the way... but yeah. We're managing to keep up on preventative maintenance, but that's coming at the cost of corrective orders sitting on the sideline. We're getting a little burried. Good news is one of the jobs for this shop has been posted, finally.
